#webDev trends I perceive:

Complexity of what is possible continues to *increase*.

Budgets for addressing the expanded possibilties continue to *decrease*. In part because of the advent of LLMs which promise to do the grunt work, but also because the capital available is contracting for other reasons.

This is a recipe for enshittification and a lack of care, and thousands more pissed off designers and developers
